head: 1d771ea853d337cd77a1da18471da18e8aa43cb1
method: Independent bounded source reviews of domain/data, platform/monetization and UI; production entry-to-result tracing, existing assertions and receipts inspected. No production/spec/test changes. This is a review report, not a launcher-generated acceptance receipt. Code findings below were established by source tracing; new device reproductions were not executed.

coverage.assessment: Production first-run/setup/navigation paths and tests present; no new scoped finding.
Offline versioned catalog, eight stable IDs, recipe CRUD and snapshot paths present; no new scoped finding.
Cadence/continuous suggestions, confirmation and capacity paths present; no new scoped finding.
Observation/photo CRUD, compensation/private storage and restart paths present; no new scoped finding.
Fail-closed controller and consent paths present, iOS ads disabled; UI request lifecycle gaps F01, F02.
Native Crashlytics configuration/toggle paths present; configured RC symbolication remains conditional.
Resources/themes/adaptive/offline paths present; accessibility defects F07, F08 and missing natural runtime acceptance.

findings.title: Advertising eligibility outlives privacy expiry on an open screen
findings.detail: adUnitId is retained and prepare is keyed only by activeComponent and placement, without expiry invalidation. The banner can remain visible past expiry; lazy-slot re-entry calls the Android factory with this retained ID and loadAd bypasses privacy.resolve.
findings.proofNeeded: Short-lived valid eligibility, remain on catalog past expiry, recycle the lazy ad slot; assert no stale visible ad/request.

findings.title: Lazy slot recreation permits multiple loads during one screen visit
findings.detail: AdvertisingVisitGate guards prepare, but InlineAdSession is remember-local to the lazy item. Disposing and re-entering creates a fresh session and calls loadAd again. Current root tests use screenHeight=6000 and do not test slot recycling.
findings.proofNeeded: Compact production RootApp test scrolls ad item out/in and asserts one SDK load per visit.

findings.title: Assigned active batch cannot be made temporarily unassigned from UI
findings.detail: assign-overflow is offered only to already-unassigned batches. confirm-stage and correct-batch do not accept an unassigned choice. Manager-level tests call the hidden operation directly.
findings.proofNeeded: Public UI path: assigned A -> real move to full B -> select temporary unassigned; restart verifies placement.

findings.title: Historical zone snapshot is not readable after closing a batch
findings.detail: close sets Placement.None; History/detail identity uses only current Assigned placement. Historical event placement snapshots remain internally, but timeline projection omits them. Closing, then renaming/deleting the zone leaves no original zone in history/detail.
findings.proofNeeded: Close batch grown on Shelf A; rename/delete zone; reopen app and assert original zone name in History/detail.

findings.title: Restore validation allows action-ID collisions between batches
findings.detail: Uniqueness is checked within a batch only. Two different batches can have actions with equal IDs and valid own batchId. Today distinctBy drops one; updateAction selects the first matching batch. Actions are JSON, without SQL global uniqueness.
findings.proofNeeded: Corrupt archive fixture with cross-batch duplicate action IDs must reject before replacement and leave live DB/photos/reminders unchanged.

findings.title: Tray preset rows omit shape and metric dimensions
findings.detail: Projection and ContextualEntityList render name only, without Rectangle/Circle and cm dimensions. Existing light golden visually confirms this.
findings.proofNeeded: Mixed shapes list with localized geometry at 200% in EN/RU, including accessible shape names.

findings.title: Date/time controls lack contextual accessible names and associated errors
findings.detail: Field label/error are sibling Text. Focusable date/time/clear buttons contain only raw value or generic Choose/Clear. No field-specific name/error semantics associates validation or DST errors with controls.
findings.proofNeeded: Semantics assertions for two temporal fields plus native TalkBack/VoiceOver traversal.

findings.title: Completion/reschedule lacks explicit accessibility announcement and focus handoff
findings.detail: Operation editor closes on completionRevision; snooze dialog dispatches and closes. Refreshed task/timeline text has no success announcement mechanism or stable explicit focus handoff. Exact native spoken behavior remains unexecuted.
findings.proofNeeded: Complete/reschedule actual action with screen reader; verify localized feedback and logical focus destination.

findings.title: iOS daily summaries stop after the 30-day queued horizon without reopening
findings.detail: iOS schedules up to 30 one-shot summaries with repeats=false and no background replenishment path. Day31 without foreground reconciliation has no summary despite pending/overdue work. No 30-day exemption exists in spec.
findings.proofNeeded: Deterministic beyond-horizon scheduling scenario and macOS native acceptance; document a product limitation only if explicitly approved.

findings.title: Permanent Android notification denial is misclassified on recheck
findings.detail: !areNotificationsEnabled branch returns canRequestAgain=true on API33+, bypassing requested/rationale logic. After permanent denial/resume UI offers a permission request that OS cannot display; Settings recovery still exists.
findings.proofNeeded: Native twice-denied/resume scenario asserts permanently denied state and settings recovery.

verification.visualHashValidation: Passed 2026-10-24: 249 production images across all 16 screens.
verification.sourceComparison: Previously audited workingFiles hashes matched current files; initial git status clean.

localGradle.detail: Repeated local matrix produced no task output for roughly 7 minutes. JVM thread inspection showed Gradle cache cleanup (FineGrainedMarkAndSweepLeastRecentlyUsedCacheCleanup), not test execution. Stopped only the verified review-owned wrapper client PID 20624. No test/build success is claimed for this attempt. Current-commit successful CI and previously executed matching-source evidence were inspected instead.

verification.ciLogEvidence: Six iosSimulatorArm64Test tasks executed; data task skipped. Simulator framework, embedAndSignAppleFrameworkForXcode and xcodebuild build succeeded. No native platform/compose/data iosTest sources exercise the OS notification/picker flows; existing common fixture tests do not substitute for native acceptance.
verification.nativeBoundary: Natural current-app TalkBack/VoiceOver, iOS picker/notification/device lifecycle acceptance not substantiated by CI build steps alone. Previous blanket absence of iOS build/CI evidence is superseded by current-commit successful CI.
